import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
Y1=np.load('Y1.npy');U1=np.load('U1.npy');Y2=np.load('Y2.npy');U2=np.load('U2.npy')
# concatenate with continuity (data1 then data2 contiguous)
Y=np.r_[Y1,Y2];U=np.r_[U1,U2]
t=np.arange(4,len(U))
X=np.c_[U[t-3,0],U[t-2,1]]; y=Y[t,1]
def m_tanh(p,X): return p[3]*np.tanh(p[0]+p[1]*X[:,0]+p[2]*X[:,1])
def m_clip(p,X): return np.clip(p[0]+p[1]*X[:,0]+p[2]*X[:,1],-p[3],p[3])
for f in [m_tanh,m_clip]:
    r=least_squares(lambda p:f(p,X)-y,[1,-1.5,1.8,1.0])
    e=f(r.x,X)-y
    print(f.__name__,r.x.round(3),np.std(e).round(4), np.abs(e).max().round(3))
    m=np.abs(y)<0.9
    print(' inner', np.std(e[m]).round(3), m.sum())
